an3.110:1.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an3.110:1.2: citte gahapati byāpanne kāyakammampi byāpannaṃ hoti vacīkammampi byāpannaṃ hoti manokammampi byāpannaṃ hoti
an3.110:1.3: tassa byāpannakāyakammassa byāpannavacīkammassa byāpannamanokammassa na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti na bhaddikā kālakiriyā
an3.110:1.4: seyyathāpi gahapati kūṭāgāre ducchanne kūṭampi byāpannaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyopi byāpannā honti bhittipi byāpannā hoti
an3.110:1.6: na bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti na bhaddikā kālakiriyā
an3.110:2.1: citte gahapati abyāpanne kāyakammampi abyāpannaṃ hoti vacīkammampi abyāpannaṃ hoti manokammampi abyāpannaṃ hoti
an3.110:2.2: tassa abyāpannakāyakammassa abyāpannavacīkammassa abyāpannamanokammassa bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ hoti bhaddikā kālakiriyā
an3.110:2.3: seyyathāpi gahapati kūṭāgāre succhanne kūṭampi abyāpannaṃ hoti gopāṇasiyopi abyāpannā honti bhittipi abyāpannā hoti
